title: Fix a recurring parallel checkout CI failure
scope: Authored realistic QA scenario. Synthetic tokens, calls, cache partitions and outcomes; no real CI execution or measured optimization gain.

events.title: Start with the native harness
events.evidence: Native instructions and selected project guidance are assembled. No task or model call yet.

events.title: Define the QA contract
events.evidence: Investigate intermittent empty-cart CI failures. Determine product versus test defect; preserve checkout behavior; require local and CI evidence.

events.title: Load only the investigation skill
events.evidence: Load the diagnosis protocol and selected checkout test/fixture paths. Keep unrelated skills discoverable, not fully loaded.

events.title: Read the failing CI shard
events.evidence: Authored CI #1841: cart expected 2 items, received 0; failures cluster in the parallel checkout shard. Classification remains unknown.

events.title: Reproduce with parallel workers
events.evidence: Authored local parallel repro fails intermittently with the same empty-cart assertion. Save full diagnostics and source anchors.

events.title: Compare the isolated run
events.evidence: Authored isolated run passes; parallel replay fails. This narrows the hypothesis but does not yet prove a test defect.

events.title: Trace fixture and product ownership
events.evidence: tests/fixtures/cart.ts exposes one mutable shared cart; another spec clears it. Product handler uses the supplied cart ID.

events.title: Classify the defect with counterevidence
events.evidence: Authored evidence supports test-fixture interference. A unique cart prevents cross-test clearing; no product change is justified by the observed evidence.

events.title: Agree on the regression and fix
events.evidence: Make the competing clear operation deterministic, then scope cart creation/cleanup to each test. Retain source-linked review objections.

events.title: Watch the regression fail before the fix
events.evidence: Authored regression deterministically exposes the shared-cart collision before fixture isolation. This is scenario evidence, not a test executed by this presentation.

events.title: Patch the test fixture
events.evidence: Change tests/fixtures/cart.ts to allocate a cart per test and clean up only that ID. Keep product checkout files unchanged.

events.title: Review the diff against the hypothesis
events.evidence: Check fixture ownership, cleanup and test determinism. Reject unrelated product changes and preserve the original failure anchor.

events.title: Run the targeted local regression
events.evidence: Authored targeted checkout regression passes on scenario revision qa-fix-r2. Record the command and report path.

events.title: Repeat the parallel failure mode
events.evidence: Authored 20 parallel repeats pass with per-test carts. Repetition increases evidence; it is not a universal flake-free guarantee.

events.title: Run related checkout coverage
events.evidence: Authored related checkout suite passes locally on qa-fix-r2. CI is still not run; local success does not establish CI success.

events.title: Prepare for native compaction
events.evidence: Store goal, constraints, diagnosis, revision, source anchors and pending CI acceptance in a validated checkpoint. Native auto-compaction is already a harness capability.

events.title: Restore relevant state after compaction
events.evidence: History is summarized; restore the small checkpoint and reopen exact fixture/test anchors. Base instructions remain included. CI acceptance remains pending.

events.title: Push the reviewed revision with authorization
events.evidence: In this authored workflow, prior user authorization covers pushing qa-fix-r2. Without it, prepare the diff/evidence and ask before pushing. No hook grants push permission.

events.title: Start CI and preserve its run identity
events.evidence: Authored CI #1842 is queued for qa-fix-r2. Record revision + run ID. Pending is not passed.

events.title: Inspect the matching CI shard
events.evidence: Authored CI #1842 checkout shard passes on qa-fix-r2; inspect the actual job/test report rather than trusting a notification. Other required jobs may still be pending.

events.title: Confirm all required CI checks
events.evidence: Authored required jobs pass for the same revision qa-fix-r2. This completes the example acceptance gate; it is not a real CI run from our experiments.

events.title: Reconcile local and remote evidence
events.evidence: Match local reports, CI #1842 and qa-fix-r2. Retain the test-defect rationale, changed paths and any remaining coverage limits.

events.title: Deliver a traceable completion packet
events.evidence: Example result: per-test cart isolation, source-linked diagnosis, local commands/status and same-revision CI evidence. Save remaining work and uncertainty explicitly.

workers.name: CI evidence
workers.purpose: Extract the failing shard, revision and repro conditions; no editing.

workers.name: Fixture review
workers.purpose: Compare fixture ownership with product code; critique the diagnosis.

workers.name: Verification
workers.purpose: Read local/CI reports and check revision-linked acceptance; coordinator runs tests.
